newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Egypt's Mubarak to visit Saudi, UAE after Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak to visit Saudi, UAE after Kuwait.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak is due to visit Saudi Arabia on Saturday after a brief stop in Kuwait as part of a Gulf tour expected to focus largely on the stalled Middle East peace process.

On Friday, Mubarak told Egyptian television that he was opposed to holding an Arab summit at the moment for fear it could further complicate the peace talks by taking collective measures against Israel.
But a mini-summit could be held "for the sake of peace and not to take decisions," he added.
Israel's start last month on construction of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem brought the peace process to a halt.
Mubarak, who last visited Kuwait in 1993, was received at the airport by the Gulf state's Emir Sheikh Jabr al-Ahmad al-Sabah.

Sources accompanying the Egyptian leader said Mubarak would fly to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, later on Saturday. In Cairo, an official said Mubarak would also visit the United Arab Emirates during his Gulf tour.
The official Kuwaiti News Agency earlier said that Mubarak would discuss several issues "mainly the setback in the Middle East peace process".
